responsibility: Implements the TILE-Gx C-family preprocessor hook TARGET_CPU_CPP_BUILTINS. It defines the target-identification, chip-version, 32-bit-mode, compare-and-swap capability, endianness, and GNU user OS builtin macros/assertions that the front end exposes to source code, providing the C/C++ preprocessing view of the TILE-Gx target rather than RTL code generation behavior.
